# ADR-3120: A10: Documented partner callback to private link 12

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

PrivateLink is intentional private reachability.

## Decision

Integrations MAY adopt a documented partner callback to private link 12 (A10-12) when a partner requires PrivateLink delivery.

## Consequences

Allow-lists are account-scoped.
